d:
It is time for the first music video from the LP 'Valliamma Peraandi Vol. 01'. Watch the stirring and intense music video for the hard-hitting 'Thodaadha' featuring Arivu directed by KalpanaAmbedkar. The video is sure to hold a mirror to the society and is bound to make some serious noise.
ARTISTS
Composed By: ARIVU
Artist : Arivu
Vocals- Arivu
Lyrics: Arivu
Music Producer: Quazi mode
Additional Vocals and Instrumentals: Alweya, Schnochild
